The remaining 6.6KB over 172 is real capability the element must carry, because it renders ARBITRARY author markup and can fold nothing away: the canvas tier-2 command plane and the ink law, the plot shapes, the AI kit's primitives and the twelve type-role rules all land in the kernel and dom this element links whole. The input list was audited for waste and carries no router, SSR, service-worker or OTA plane - nothing structurally unreachable. 185 leaves ~3.5% headroom: enough that a rounding change does not red the release build, tight enough that another wave of this size does. the default 40KB widget budget stays law — a package that needs more must say so here, and the build prints the override loudly. origins ['*'] because the editor exists to be embedded anywhere. No native facet on purpose: the editor is the design surface FOR decks, not a deck capability — it badges web-only and degrades honestly on native (Article 7).
